retirements.rationale: The preview is a wizard-only explanatory affordance rather than an independent geolocation capability. Native coverage verifies geolocation resolution, frontend currency projection, selected-currency control and settings management, while the retained contract owns the merchant-visible automatic-geolocation opt-in. Recreating the legacy preview iframe and its exact copy would preserve obsolete plugin structure rather than add distinct behavioural coverage.
